~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Test Router HSRP Standby ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
ip multicast-routing vrf {VRF_name}
!
ip vrf {VRF_name}
  mdt default {mdt_default_address}
  mdt data {mdt_data_address} {User_prefix_netmask} threshold 10
  mdt log-reuse
!
interface Loopback20000
  description RP Loopback for VRF {VRF_name}
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address 10.239.0.0 255.255.255.255
  ip pim sparse-dense-mode
!
ip pim vrf {VRF_name} rp-address 10.239.0.0
!
interface Loopback20002
  description MSDP Loopback for VRF {VRF_name}
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address 10.239.0.2 255.255.255.255
  ip pim sparse-dense-mode
!
ip msdp vrf {VRF_name} peer 10.239.0.1 connect-source Loopback20002
ip msdp vrf {VRF_name} cache-sa-state
ip msdp vrf {VRF_name} originator-id Loopback20002
!
! ########### MULTICAST END ############# 

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ Test Router HSRP Active ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
ip multicast-routing vrf {VRF_name}
!
ip vrf {VRF_name}
  mdt default {mdt_default_address}
  mdt data {mdt_data_address} {User_prefix_netmask} threshold 10
  mdt log-reuse
!
interface Loopback20000
  description RP Loopback for VRF {VRF_name}
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address 10.239.0.0 255.255.255.255
  ip pim sparse-dense-mode
!
ip pim vrf {VRF_name} rp-address 10.239.0.0
!
interface Loopback20001
  description MSDP Loopback for VRF {VRF_name}
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address 10.239.0.1 255.255.255.255
  ip pim sparse-dense-mode
!
ip msdp vrf {VRF_name} peer 10.239.0.2 connect-source Loopback20001
ip msdp vrf {VRF_name} cache-sa-state
ip msdp vrf {VRF_name} originator-id Loopback20001
!
! ########### MULTICAST END #############
